panel.login.title: Sign in to Boardmix
panel.login.body: This is Boardmix's own login page. Sign in here and the session stays with this panel; the plugin never sees your credentials.

skill.boardmix.name: Boardmix Whiteboard
skill.boardmix.description: Open the panel, get signed in, and land on the right Boardmix screen — then hand the last click to you.
skill.boardmix-canvas.name: Draw on the Canvas
skill.boardmix-canvas.description: Turn notes into a mind map, flowchart or sticky wall the canvas can absorb, with the exact panel path to place it.
skill.boardmix-collaboration.name: Share and Collaborate
skill.boardmix-collaboration.description: Pick the permission tier, invite the right people, and run a review or workshop without hitting an organisation limit.
skill.boardmix-ai.name: Generate with Boardmix AI
skill.boardmix-ai.description: Reach Boardmix's own AI for decks, diagrams and docs, with a prompt worth pasting before you spend a point.
skill.boardmix-io.name: Import and Export
skill.boardmix-io.description: Bring PPT, PDF or Mermaid into a board, or export for a client — with the watermark and size limits said up front.
agent.boardmix-guide.name: Whiteboard Guide
agent.boardmix-guide.description: Works the Boardmix panel for you: opens the right screen, writes the diagram or the prompt, and tells you the one click left.
